name: LyricBridge
overview:
Word-by-word karaoke lyrics, translations, and pronunciation for Jellyfin
      Web.
description:
Follow your music with synchronized karaoke lyrics in Jellyfin Web.
      Search multiple lyric providers, import lyrics, and save your preferred versions. Display
      translations and pronunciation alongside the original lyrics, with optional tools to generate
      missing language support or transcribe audio.
